licenseinfo.notes:
The process to produce this image is as follows:
i) Find the icons to use at game-icons.net (e.g. https://game-icons.net/1x1/delapouite/shamrock.html and https://game-icons.net/1x1/lorc/plain-dagger.html) ii) Set the foregrounds to black and the backgrounds to 100% transparency (and circular). iii) Download as svg. iv) Go to https://baronofdice.com/en-au/products/custom-d20 v) Drop in icon, select the colours, and fiddle till you're happy. vi) Screenshot the page vii) Edit in gimp. viii) Drop into inkscape.
